summary: Panel kit: draw dialogs and buttons from the staged kit in the client (task)
author: client
body:
Goal (user, 2026-11-24): "It looks significantly better - ship it" - draw the HH-0054 panel kit in the client; "Once everything is rebuilt, drop the old sprites".

Plan: `.claude/design/plans/panel-kit-runtime.md` (steps 1-8; each sub-task is one step).
Kit: `staged/client/sprites/panelkit/` built by `tools/panel_kit/build_panel_kit.py` (`--check` proves byte-for-byte); reference composer `tools/panel_kit/compose.py` (the client must match it).

Decisions: Character List plates stay as they are; flourish colour is a runtime parameter; buttons tile the 25 px face, never stretch.

Done when every sub-task is done and every converted dialog and button draws and works in game.
